3D viewer needs internet

This page loads three.js and OrbitControls from a CDN (unpkg / jsdelivr). The CDN could not be reached, so the 3D scene cannot render.

Connect to the internet and reload, or vendor a local copy of three.module.js + OrbitControls.js next to this file and adjust the import map.
